findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Irreducible.lean:73 `theorem IsIrreducible.nontrivial {ρ : Representation k G V} (h : ρ.IsIrreducible) : Nontrivial V`, whose body is the same three steps; it is consumed this way at TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Continuous/Unitary/Equivalence.lean:88 `have _ : Nontrivial V := Representation.IsIrreducible.nontrivial hirr`.
findings.fix: Replace lines 224-229 with `have _ : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (models i).dim)) := (models i).isIrreducible.nontrivial` and keep `Module.finrank_pos`.
findings.issue: The `hdim` block re-derives `Nontrivial` of the carrier from `IsSimpleModule.nontrivial` plus `asModuleEquiv`, which is exactly `TauCeti.Representation.IsIrreducible.nontrivial`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Subspace.lean:44 `theorem Orthonormal.codRestrict (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (s : Submodule 𝕜 E) (hvs : ∀ i, v i ∈ s) : Orthonormal 𝕜 (Set.codRestrict v s hvs) := s.subtypeₗᵢ.orthonormal_comp_iff.mp hv`.
findings.fix: Prove it as `hL2.codRestrict _ fun i ↦ ContRepresentation.characterLp_mem_classFunctionLp _ _` (`characterFamily models` is `Set.codRestrict` of the ambient family up to defeq), dropping the `classical`/`orthonormal_iff_ite` scaffolding.
findings.issue: `orthonormal_characterFamily` re-proves, via `orthonormal_iff_ite` and `Submodule.coe_inner`, that an orthonormal family lying in a submodule is orthonormal in that submodule.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Continuous/MatrixCoefficient.lean:217 `(matrixCoeff π hπ v w).comp (ContinuousMap.mulRight g₀) = matrixCoeff π hπ (π g₀ v) w`; :247 `(matrixCoeff π hπ v w).comp (ContinuousMap.mulLeft g₀) = matrixCoeff π hπ v (π g₀⁻¹ w)` (:152 and :231 are the pointwise versions).
findings.fix: Get `key` at the `C(G, 𝕜)` level from `matrixCoeff_comp_mulRight π hπ v w h` followed by `matrixCoeff_comp_mulLeft hπ hunitary (π h v) w h⁻¹` (both `@[simp]`, and `π (h⁻¹)⁻¹ w = π h w`), then push through `matrixCoeffLp_def`; the pointwise forms `matrixCoeff_apply_mul_right`/`matrixCoeff_apply_mul_left` serve equally.
findings.issue: In `inner_matrixCoeffLp_map_map`, the identity `matrixCoeff π (π h v) (π h w) g = matrixCoeff π v w (h⁻¹ * g * h)` (`hL`, and hence `key`) is re-derived from `hunitary.inner_map_right` and `map_mul` although it is the composition of two existing translation lemmas.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Compact/RegularRepresentation.lean:88-99 `rightRegularLp_toLp ... rw [rightRegularLp_apply, Lp.ext_iff]; refine (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving _ _).trans ...`; no Mathlib lemma relates `compMeasurePreserving` and `ContinuousMap.toLp` (grep of Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/ContinuousFunctions.lean and Basic.lean:561-635 shows none).
findings.fix: Factor the general statement out once (e.g. `Lp.compMeasurePreserving_toLp (F : C(α, E)) (φ : C(α, β)) (hφ : MeasurePreserving φ μ ν)`) in `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/Lp/CompMeasurePreservingEquiv.lean`, and derive both `invLpₗᵢ_toLp` and `rightRegularLp_toLp` from it.
findings.issue: `invLpₗᵢ_toLp` is a near-clone of the existing `rightRegularLp_toLp`: both prove `Lp.compMeasurePreserving φ hφ (ContinuousMap.toLp p μ 𝕜 F) = ContinuousMap.toLp p μ 𝕜 (F.comp φ)` by the same `Lp.ext` / `quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq` plumbing, for two different measure-preserving continuous `φ`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/Basic.lean:604 `compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply`; TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Group/Conjugation.lean:194,207,213 supply `conjLpₗᵢ`, `conjLpₗᵢ_eq_smul`, `conjLpₗᵢ_apply_of_mem_classFunctionLp` under the same `[Fact (1 ≤ p)]`, `[MeasurableMul G]`, `[SMulInvariantMeasure (ConjAct G) G μ]` hypotheses that this section already assumes.
findings.fix: Use `Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply` on both composites together with `conjLpₗᵢ`/`conjLpₗᵢ_eq_smul` and `conjLpₗᵢ_apply_of_mem_classFunctionLp` (all in the imported `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Group/Conjugation.lean`), instead of the two `quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq` steps.
findings.issue: `invLpₗᵢ_mem_classFunctionLp` re-derives, by hand at the representative level, that precomposition with conjugation commutes with precomposition with inversion, although both sides are `Lp.compMeasurePreserving` of composite maps that are equal on the nose (`(h * g * h⁻¹)⁻¹ = h * g⁻¹ * h⁻¹`).

summary: The new mathematics is not duplicated, but several proofs re-derive lemmas that already exist in the repository or Mathlib, and `invLpₗᵢ_toLp` is a near-clone of `rightRegularLp_toLp`. No declaration is directly replaced by an existing one.
